shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -50

head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; ls src __agent_eval__; cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80
.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar ThemeProvider FormRow 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Text Flex Card Avatar FormRow 2>&1 | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head -60; cat controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; cat Select/types.d.ts | head -120

cat Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | grep -v '^import' | head -120; grep -n "Variant\|export type TextProps" -A3 Text/Text.d.ts | head -30; grep -n "gap\|direction\|alignItems" layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head; ls controls/TextInput; grep -n "label\|note\|startContent" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head; grep -n "view\|type\|loading\|disabled\|onClick" Button/Button.d.ts | head -20; ls ControlLabel; cat ControlLabel/ControlLabel.d.ts | grep -v import

cat Avatar/types.d.ts | grep -v import | head -40; grep -n "ControlProps" -A25 controls/types.d.ts | head -50; grep -rn "TextVariant\b" Text/types.d.ts | head -3; grep -n "variant\|color\|as" Text/Text.d.ts | head; grep -n "type\|theme" Card/Card.d.ts | head; cat layout/spacing/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -0

sed -n 1,60p Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | grep -v "^import"; grep -n "ControlProps" -B2 -A22 types.d.ts | head -50; grep -n "variant\|color" Text/text/text.d.ts Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "required\|Required" -r FilePreview/*.d.ts | head -2; grep -rn "ControlProps\b" controls/index.d.ts types.d.ts | head -3

cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts | head -8; ls Avatar; grep -v "^import" Avatar/definitions.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; grep -n "TEXT_COLORS" -A3 Text/colorText/constants.js; sed -n 1,30p Text/text/constants.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -n "Space =" -r layout/*.d.ts layout/**/*.d.ts | head -3

grep -v "^import" Avatar/types/main.d.ts | head -40; cat Avatar/constants.js | head -8; grep -rn "secondary" Text/*.js ../constants/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3; grep -rn "'secondary'" Text/colorText/ | head -2
